settings.fixedIdentity: Exactly2period vehicles: truck left-X, van rear/right+X/+Y; both nose-Y. Generator front/right, bench/reel positions fixed; front service gap remains open; no slab.

coordinate_system: metres; front y=-depth/2; right x=+width/2; z up; ONE model rotated0/90/180/270 about z
depth_handling: orthographic triangle rasterization, barycentric per-pixel depth, keep nearest; no average-depth painter guess
svg_form: self-contained exact technical z-buffer raster; editable full world mesh is stored separately

source_brief.functionalIdentity: A30x20m event broadcast compound consisting of one period box broadcast truck, one uplink van with a roof dish, a generator box, cable reels and a small practical equipment workbench. Arrange truck left, van rear-right, generator front-right, with one open service gap at model front; fixed component layout rotates as one object. Separate physical feet/wheels and no painted ground slab. It must read as support vehicles, not a garage.
